# Disk Cleaner

> The ultimate open-source native disk cleanup, storage optimizer, app uninstaller, and duplicate finder for macOS, iOS, Android, and Windows. Single native binary, zero network telemetry, 100% privacy.

## Overview
Disk Cleaner is a multiplatform open-source utility designed to recover tens of gigabytes of disk space safely. Built in pure Swift & SwiftUI for macOS/iOS, Kotlin for Android, and C# for Windows.

## Key Capabilities & Risk Classification
Every cleanup target is classified into one of three strict risk categories:
- **`safe`**: Pure cache files (Xcode DerivedData, Homebrew cache, CocoaPods, browser caches) that auto-regenerate automatically.
- **`rebuild`**: Build artifacts and package manager caches (npm, yarn, cargo, docker containers) that cost a re-download or re-compile.
- **`review`**: User documents, Downloads items, and Trash — never auto-selected.

## Safety Chokepoints
- `Cleaner.allowed()` gate strictly rejects any file operation outside `$HOME` and protects `$HOME` root directory.
- All deletions default to Finder Trash.
- Process guard prevents quitting system daemons or other users' processes.
